AN ORDINANCE OF THE TOWN OF PINE MOUNTAIN, GEORGIA TO REGULATE AND GOVERN YARD AND GARAGE SALES BEING HELD WITHIN THE TOWN IN ANY AGRICULTURAL OR RESIDENTIAL ZONING DISTRICT; TO PROVIDE AN EFFECTIVE DATE; TO REPEAL ALL ODRINANCES AND PARTS OF ORDINANCES IN CONFLICT HEREWITH; AND FOR OTHER LAWFUL PURPOSES

WHEREAS, the Town of Pine Mountain, Georgia (the “Town”) desires to adopt an ordinance to govern yard and garage sales held in agricultural and residential zoning districts within the Town;

WHEREAS, the Mayor and Council of the Town have determined that it is in the best interest of the Town and its citizens to adopt an ordinance governing yard and sales.
